q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT DISTINCT EMAIL FROM PERSON P1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PERSON P2 WHERE P2.EMAIL = P1.EMAIL) > 1

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects emails that appear more than once in the PERSON table, while Q2 selects distinct emails that have more than one occurrence in the table.
